task_completion.description: Define 5 functional zones (Adult Reading, Children's, Reference Stacks, Circulation Desk, Staff Workroom) using room names or text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for text labels or room names on the 2D floor plan corresponding to the five specific zones mentioned.

task_completion.description: Apply distinct floor colors or textures to at least 3 of the functional zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 2D or 3D view, check if at least three different rooms/areas have clearly different floor patterns or colors.

task_completion.description: Place at least 10 shelving units (bookcases/shelves) in the Reference Stacks area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the number of bookcase/shelf icons in the 2D plan or 3D models; there must be at least 10.

task_completion.description: Place at least 6 tables and 12 chairs in the reading/study areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the tables and chairs across the floor plan. Ensure there are >= 6 tables and >= 12 chairs.

task_completion.description: Place at least 2 desks for circulation, 4 lamps, 3 plants/decor items, and 3 wayfinding text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Verify the presence of 2 desks, 4 lamp objects, 3 plant/decor objects, and 3 additional text labels (separate from zone names) for wayfinding.
Look for the 'Save As' dialog box with the specific path typed in, or the file name appearing in the Sweet Home 3D title bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place items rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, dragging items, or the 3D view updating incrementally.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-existing completed file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the progression of adding furniture and labels to the empty villa shell over time.

integrity.description: Items are sourced from the built-in catalog.
integrity.visual_evidence: The furniture list on the left side of the Sweet Home 3D interface should show standard categories (Tables, Chairs, etc.) being used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create 5 specific zones (Adult Reading, Children's, Reference, Circulation, Staff). Requirements: >= 10 shelves, >= 6 tables, >= 12 chairs, >= 2 desks, >= 4 lamps, >= 3 plants, and >= 3 wayfinding labels. At least 3 zones must have unique floor textures. Total furniture count must reach at least 40 items for full credit. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Documents/library_design.sh3d.
